ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels and 15% low-intensity black pixels localized primarily at the margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous central regions on both lobes; thick black border along the entire trailing edge; distinct dark vertical marking on the mid-left lobe; several dark focal spots and linear clusters on the distal right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 70 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to the fluke baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the distal margins; extreme pixel-level irregularity at the tips due to epibiotic clusters; moderate irregularity along the interior trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the notch transitioning to a downward-tapering curve towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, irregular high-contrast dark clusters at the extreme tips of both lobes (barnacle colonization); small, sparse circular dark spots (diameter < 5px) in the central white zones.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical dark linear disruption on the left lobe; multiple unaligned, intersecting linear rake marks on the distal portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the lateral tips of both lobes; distinct multiple parallel rake marks on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced lumpy, irregular silhouettes at the distal tips caused by heavy biological loading, exceeding the natural geometric boundary of the fluke.
